mapper.select: select count(1) from mall_order where create_time >= #{from} and create_time < #{to}
select coalesce(sum(payable_amount),0) from mall_order where payment_status='PAID' and pay_time >= #{from} and pay_time < #{to}
select count(distinct member_id) from mall_order where payment_status='PAID' and pay_time >= #{from} and pay_time < #{to}
select count(1) from (select member_id from mall_order where payment_status='PAID' and pay_time >= #{from} and pay_time < #{to} group by member_id having count(1) > 1) t
select count(1) from mall_order where status='PENDING_SHIPMENT'
select count(1) from mall_logistics_shipment where status='IN_TRANSIT'
select count(1) from mall_logistics_shipment where status='DELIVERED' and delivered_time >= #{from} and delivered_time < #{to}

select count(1) from mall_sku k left join mall_stock s on s.sku_id=k.sku_id where k.del_flag='0' and k.status='1' and coalesce(s.available_quantity,k.available_stock,0) <= coalesce(s.warning_threshold,0)
select coalesce(sum(coalesce(s.available_quantity,k.available_stock,0)),0) from mall_sku k left join mall_stock s on s.sku_id=k.sku_id where k.del_flag='0' and k.status='1'
select count(1) from mall_item_after_sale where status in ('PENDING_REVIEW','RETURN_SHIPPED','REFUNDING')
select count(1) from mall_item_after_sale where create_time >= #{from} and create_time < #{to}
select coalesce(sum(refund_amount + shipping_refund_amount),0) from mall_item_after_sale where status='SUCCESS' and refund_time >= #{from} and refund_time < #{to}

select (select count(1) from mall_reconciliation_diff where status='OPEN') + (select count(1) from mall_reconciliation_alert where status='OPEN') + (select count(1) from mall_compensation_task where status in ('PENDING','FAILED','MANUAL_REQUIRED'))

select date_format(pay_time,'%Y-%m-%d') date_label, coalesce(sum(payable_amount),0) amount, count(1) order_count from mall_order where payment_status='PAID' and pay_time >= #{from} and pay_time < #{to} group by date_format(pay_time,'%Y-%m-%d') order by date_label

select oi.product_name label, sum(oi.quantity) quantity, coalesce(sum(oi.line_amount),0) amount from mall_order_item oi join mall_order o on o.order_id=oi.order_id where o.payment_status='PAID' and o.pay_time >= #{from} and o.pay_time < #{to} group by oi.product_name order by amount desc limit #{limit}
